text.autoconfig.smartautomine.title: Smart Auto Mine
text.autoconfig.smartautomine.option.min: Stop (or switch tools) before durability drops below this absolute value.
Stop (or switch tools) before durability drops below this percentage.
text.autoconfig.smartautomine.option.hun: On (default): auto-disable if hunger drops below the threshold below.
text.autoconfig.smartautomine.option.ign: On: skip the hunger safety stop entirely while you have Regeneration (e.g. near a beacon).
text.autoconfig.smartautomine.option.hea: On (default): react once health drops below the threshold below - stop, or pause-and-eat if the option below is on.
text.autoconfig.smartautomine.option.eat: Off (default): the health safety stop above just auto-disables. On: instead, pause (incl. all timers) and force-feed from Auto-eat until hunger is full, then wait for health to climb 2 hearts above the threshold before resuming. Gives up after 45 seconds. Needs an auto-eat food source configured.
text.autoconfig.smartautomine.option.ign: On: skip the health safety stop/pause entirely while you have Regeneration (e.g. near a beacon).
text.autoconfig.smartautomine.option.par: Off (default). On: don't fully trust Regeneration - still pause-and-eat when triggered even while regenerating, so hunger never goes untended. Needs Eat to regenerate health and Auto-eat both on.
text.autoconfig.smartautomine.option.use: On: switch to another matching tool in the hotbar instead of stopping when durability runs low.
text.autoconfig.smartautomine.option.too: How replacements are picked. KEYWORD: item ID contains the keyword below. SAME_TYPE: same tool category, any material. EXACT_MATCH: identical item only.
KEYWORD mode only. e.g. 'pickaxe' matches any *_pickaxe.
text.autoconfig.smartautomine.option.reg: CONTINUOUS (default): holds the mine button, drives directly only while a screen is open. VANILLA_INPUT: only ever holds the button, pauses on screens. LEGACY: always drives directly (attack indicator flickers).
text.autoconfig.smartautomine.option.pla: Place-mine while a screen is open
VANILLA (default): pauses while a screen is open. ADVANCED (experimental): keeps placing/mining through the screen.
text.autoconfig.smartautomine.option.fin: Finish last block when offhand empties
Place-mine only. On: keep going 0.75s longer so the just-placed block still gets mined.
text.autoconfig.smartautomine.option.pau: Pause timer while mining is paused
On: the max-duration timer freezes while paused by an open screen, instead of always counting down.
text.autoconfig.smartautomine.option.fee: How to notify you of toggles/auto-stops.
text.autoconfig.smartautomine.option.wai: On (default): wait 0.5s after a bite before resuming mining.
text.autoconfig.smartautomine.option.pla: On (default): play a sound whenever the mod auto-stops itself.
text.autoconfig.smartautomine.option.res: Off (default): a manual reconnect turns the mod off. On: it resumes automatically.
text.autoconfig.smartautomine.option.aut: On (default): auto-eat is active. Off: never eats automatically.
Off (default): only eat from the slot below. On: eat the first eligible food anywhere in the hotbar.
1-9. Ignored when Search any hotbar slot is on.
Start eating once hunger drops below this (0-20).
EAT_ONCE (default): one bite per dip below the threshold. DONT_OVEREAT: keep eating without wasting nutrition past 20. FILL_HUNGER: keep eating to a full bar, regardless of waste.
text.autoconfig.smartautomine.option.foo: LIGHT (default): blocks golden apple/pufferfish. FOOD_INSPECTOR: also rotten flesh/spider eye/raw chicken/poisonous potato. RAT: no extra blocks.
